Given that $a_{n} = n^{3}$ for $n \ge 1$, which of the following statements are true?

1. $\frac{a_{n + 1}}{a_{n}} \ge 1$ for all $n \ge 1$
2. $a_{n}$ is an increasing sequence
3. $a_{n}$ is a decreasing sequence

3. $a_{n}$ is a decreasing sequence
